events.subtitle: Voice / flugelhorn + piano duo
events.factual_description: Blue Note Place presents TOKU meets Shinya Kiyozuka on Sunday, August 30, 2026 in Ebisu, Tokyo. The first set opens at 5:30 PM and starts at 6:15 PM; the second opens at 7:45 PM and starts at 8:30 PM. Each performance is scheduled for 60 minutes with turnover between sets. The official venue page lists only TOKU on vocals and flugelhorn and Shinya Kiyozuka on piano and describes the collaboration as a genre-crossing encounter between TOKU's jazz-based voice/flugelhorn identity and Kiyozuka's classical-piano practice. Kiyozuka's official artist page and TOKU's official schedule independently confirm the August 30 Blue Note Place date, exact duo billing and set times. The first show is designated Family Friendly Day by the venue.

en.why_it_matters: The reason to care is the stripped-down collision of vocabularies. TOKU can move between sung melody and flugelhorn phrasing from inside a jazz language, while Kiyozuka brings a concert-piano vocabulary rooted in classical repertoire but accustomed to crossing into popular music. With no rhythm section or additional ensemble announced, the two musicians have to carry time, harmony, texture and dynamics themselves; in a compact room, that makes the pairing a real musical proposition rather than a guest cameo.
en.trip_verdict: Actively make room for one of the two sets if August 30 is open in Tokyo. The duo is unusual enough to build the evening around, especially in a room this intimate, but I would not displace a rarer master appearance, farewell, premiere or one-off elsewhere in Kanto to make it happen.

es.why_it_matters: Lo que le gana el lugar es el choque de lenguajes en formato mínimo. TOKU puede pasar de la melodía cantada al fraseo del flugelhorn desde adentro del jazz, mientras Kiyozuka llega con un vocabulario de piano de concierto arraigado en repertorio clásico pero acostumbrado a cruzarse con música popular. Sin sección rítmica ni otro ensamble anunciado, los dos tienen que cargar por sí mismos tiempo, armonía, textura y dinámica; en una sala pequeña, eso vuelve la pareja una propuesta musical real y no un simple cameo.
es.trip_verdict: Sí le haría espacio activamente a uno de los dos sets si el 30 de agosto está libre en Tokio. El dúo es suficientemente inusual para construir la noche alrededor de él, sobre todo en una sala así de íntima, pero no desplazaría por esta fecha una aparición más rara de un maestro, una despedida, un estreno o un one-off en otro punto de Kanto.
